entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: ¶The king's heart in the hands of the Lord is like the water streams, and by him it is turned in any direction at his pleasure.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: ¶Every way of a man seems right to himself, but the Lord is the tester of hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: ¶To do what is right and true is more pleasing to the Lord than an offering.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: ¶A high look and a heart of pride, ***of the evil-doer is sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: ¶The purposes of the man of industry have their outcome only in wealth; but one who is over-quick in acting will only come to be in need.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: ¶He who gets stores of wealth by a false tongue, is going after what is only breath, and searching for death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: ¶By their violent acts the evil-doers will be pulled away, because they have no desire to do what is right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: ¶Twisted is the way of him who is full of crime; but as for him whose heart is clean, his work is upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: ¶It is better to be living in an angle of the house-top, than with a bitter-tongued woman in a wide house.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: ¶The desire of the evil-doer is fixed on evil: he has no kind feeling for his neighbour.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: ¶When the man of pride undergoes punishment, the simple man gets wisdom; and by watching the wise he gets knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: ¶The Upright One, looking on the house of the evil-doer, lets sinners be overturned to their destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: ¶He whose ears are stopped at the cry of the poor, will himself get no answer to his cry for help.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: ¶By a secret offering wrath is turned away, and the heat of angry feelings by money in the folds of the robe.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: ¶It is a joy to the good man to do right, but it is destruction to the workers of evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: ¶The wanderer from the way of knowledge will have his resting-place among the shades.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: ¶The lover of pleasure will be a poor man: the lover of wine and oil will not get wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: ¶The evil-doer will be given as a price for the life of the good man, and the worker of deceit in the place of the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: ¶It is better to be living in a waste land, than with a bitter-tongued and angry woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: ¶There is a store of great value in the house of the wise, but it is wasted by the foolish man.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: ¶He who goes after righteousness and mercy will get life, righteousness, and honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: ¶A wise man goes up into the town of the strong ones, and overcomes its strength in which they put their faith.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: ¶He who keeps watch over his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: ¶The man of pride, lifted up in soul, is named high-hearted; he is acting in an outburst of pride.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: ¶The desire of the hater of work is death to him, for his hands will do no work.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: All the day the sinner goes after his desire: but the upright man gives freely, keeping nothing back.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: ¶The offering of evil-doers is disgusting: how much more when they give it with an evil purpose!

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: ¶A false witness will be cut off, ...

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: ¶The evil-doer makes his face hard, but as for the upright, he gives thought to his way.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: ¶Wisdom and knowledge and wise suggestions are of no use against the Lord.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse is made ready for the day of war, but power to overcome is from the Lord.
